name: Partnero – Affiliate & Referral Program Management for WordPress
author: Partnero

sections.description:
Partnero – Affiliate & Referral Program Management for WordPress

Partnero is a powerful tool designed to effortlessly manage affiliate and refer-a-friend programs for any WordPress site. Whether you want to grow your user base through referrals or boost sales with affiliate traffic, Partnero provides all the essential tools to set up, track, and manage your programs effectively.

Works with any WordPress site – Track visits and user signups on any WordPress installation. When WooCommerce is installed, you get additional features like order tracking, commission calculation, and product exclusions.

Key Features:

  • Integrated Affiliate & Referral Programs: Easily set up both affiliate and refer-a-friend programs tailored to your WooCommerce store.

  • Advanced Commissions & Rewards: Set sophisticated, dynamic commission structures and engaging unique rewards.

  • White label experience: design and fine-tune every aspect of your programs to offer a fully branded experience.

  • Comprehensive Tracking & Analytics: Monitor conversions, track referral activity, and analyze performance with real-time data and reporting.

  • Automated Payouts & Reward Distribution: Save time with scheduled payouts and automated reward distribution.

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration: Built specifically for WooCommerce, Partnero works effortlessly within your store for a smooth experience.

With Partnero, you can easily increase engagement, reach new customers, and reward loyal ones—all through a fully customizable affiliate and referral program.

Explore our complete feature set here.

Please visit our knowledge base or developer documentation to find detailed how-to guides.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/partnero directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Partnero’ menu and enter Partnero API Key that can be generated from Integration section over at Partnero.
sections.changelog:
2.6.1

  • Fixed API key reconnect and rotation silently keeping the old key and program when credentials were already stored
  • WooCommerce hooks are now registered unconditionally at plugin load, fixing order tracking when Partnero loads before WooCommerce

2.6.0

  • Added support for transaction-based attribution model
  • The order’s creation date is now sent with the transaction so rewards reflect the actual purchase time
  • Partner code recovery from WooCommerce’s native order attribution now runs for every order
  • WooCommerce orders now receive a Partnero order note indicating whether a transaction and rewards were created
  • Added detailed event tracking throughout the order tracking flow to make diagnosing missing conversions easier

2.5.0

  • Added order attribution fallback: when the Partnero tracking cookie is missing (e.g. external/headless checkouts), the partner code is recovered from WooCommerce’s native order attribution data
  • Referral parameter is auto-fetched from the Partnero API and cached, with no manual configuration required
  • Recovered partner keys are persisted to order meta and sanitized against a strict allowlist

2.1.0

  • Made plugin universal – now works with plain WordPress (without WooCommerce)
  • Track visits and user signups on any WordPress site
  • WooCommerce features (order tracking, commissions) activate automatically when WooCommerce is installed
  • Added configurable order status triggers for tracking
  • Added option to include/exclude shipping in commission calculation
  • Added product category exclusion for commission tracking
  • Improved session management with PHP session fallback
  • Added “Active Features” section to dashboard showing what’s enabled
  • Security improvements for admin form handlers and input validation
  • Added error logging for API calls (WP_DEBUG mode)
  • Added internationalization (i18n) support for all user-facing strings
  • Improved WordPress coding standards compliance

2.0.5

  • Small fixes

2.0.4

  • Added date of birth metadata support for refer-a-friend program

2.0.3

  • Added support for customers date of birth metadata sync.

2.0.2

  • Remove method type declarations to support PHP 7.4

2.0.1

  • Added support to sync WooCommerce customers to Partnero Refer-A-Friend program

2.0.0

  • Added support to connect Refer-a-friend program

1.3.7

  • Fixed issue when session is null

1.3.6

  • Fixed issue when session is null

1.3.5

  • SVEA Woocommerce checkout order tracking.

1.3.4

  • Product based dynamic commission.

1.3.3

  • Stop order tracking when done from admin.

1.3.2

  • Fix tracking when payment is delayed.
  • Added extra measures to prevent duplicate calls.

1.3.1

  • Style changes for tax option.

1.3.0

  • Added option to include tax in final amount while tracking order.

1.2.0

  • Updated tracking hooks.
  • Added payment hook to tracking as a fallback measure.

1.1.0

  • Multi currency support.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
